text:
The answer names no top-level directories as containing uses of MBEDTLS_PRIVATE. It names only specific files and paths (`library/common.h`, `programs/ssl/...`, `programs/fuzz/...`, `include/mbedtls/...`, `docs/...`), and none of these is stated as a directory containing uses of the macro. Of those paths, `programs` is the one closest to a claim: it holds `ssl_context_info.c` and the fuzzer, which use `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(...)` explicitly. The answer also says `library/common.h` and the library `.c` files see the real member names. I am treating those as file-level mentions, though, since the answer never says a directory "contains uses".

Reading it as the directories the answer ties to uses of the macro, the list would be:

ITEMS:
programs
library
END
